verdict.rationale: Galileo documents an official MCP server with a dedicated setup page. It connects AI-powered IDEs such as Cursor and VS Code with GitHub Copilot to its platform and exposes tools for creating and managing datasets, running experiments, and setting up prompt templates. A probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and fuller documentation of the tool surface (e.g. trace/log querying) and auth/transport details.
